sheets.subject: Early morning: soft low clouds along the lower part, clear open sky above.
sheets.light: Soft early-morning light: pale peach and rose near the bottom edge fading up into a very pale clear blue; the clouds stay mostly white paper with a faint rose glaze on their lower edges.

sheets.subject: A clear fine day: an almost empty open sky with only a few thin high wisps of cirrus.
A grey overcast day: the whole sky one low layered cloud deck in long soft bands, no gaps.
sheets.light: Overcast: the whole canvas a pale cool grey watercolour, slightly darker bands in the cloud deck, no blue.

sheets.subject: A rain sky: heavy low clouds with slanting rain curtains falling from their undersides, a brighter gap low on one side.
sheets.light: Rain: cool blue-grey washes, darker under the clouds, the rain curtains thin slanting pale grey strokes, one pale bright gap.

sheets.subject: A clear night: a crescent moon high on one side, scattered small stars, a few thin clouds lit by the moon.
sheets.light: Night: a deep transparent blue-indigo watercolour wash over the whole canvas, a little lighter near the bottom edge; the moon and the stars stay white paper, the clouds a pale cool blue-grey.

sheets.subject: Sunset: long streaks of cloud low over where the horizon would be, the sun just gone, open sky above.
sheets.light: Sunset: warm golden orange and apricot near the bottom edge, rose in the middle, fading up into a pale blue-violet; the clouds catch warm orange on their lower edges.

sheets.subject: A misty morning: a low veil of mist, the sky almost white with soft pale cloud shapes barely drawn.
sheets.light: Mist: almost all paper white with very pale cool grey-blue veils, nearly no colour.

sheets.subject: Six clouds in two rows of three: (1) a large cumulus, (2) a small cumulus, (3) a long low bank of cloud, wide and flat, (4) a thin wisp of high cirrus, (5) a towering storm cloud with a flat anvil top, (6) a rain cloud with slanting rain streaks falling from its underside.
